Rio Tinto Plc Sp Adr (RIO) Holder Cadinha & Co Has Trimmed Its Holding by $11.51 Million; Churchill Management Has Raised Its Microsoft Com (MSFT) Holding by $572,299 as Valuation Rose
June 17, 2018 - By Linda Rogers
Cadinha & Co Llc decreased its stake in Rio Tinto Plc Sp Adr (RIO) by 97.83% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Cadinha & Co Llc sold 225,722 shares as the company’s stock declined 1.78% with the market. The institutional investor held 5,010 shares of the precious metals company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $258,000, down from 230,732 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Cadinha & Co Llc who had been investing in Rio Tinto Plc Sp Adr for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $98.43 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 2.92% or $1.71 during the last trading session, reaching $56.79. About 3.67 million shares traded or 40.94% up from the average. Rio Tinto plc (NYSE:RIO) has risen 37.67% since June 17, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 25.10% the S&P500. Churchill Management Corp increased its stake in Microsoft Corp Com (MSFT) by 20.1% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Churchill Management Corp bought 6,289 shares as the company’s stock rose 3.08% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 37,580 shares of the prepackaged software company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $3.43 million, up from 31,291 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Churchill Management Corp who had been investing in Microsoft Corp Com for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $769.32B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.27% or $1.29 during the last trading session, reaching $100.13. About 37.25M shares traded or 26.19% up from the average. Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ:MSFT) has risen 41.28% since June 17, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 28.71% the S&P500. Cadinha & Co Llc, which manages about $952.64 million and $495.62 million US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Johnson & Johnson (NYSE:JNJ) by 6,221 shares to 188,065 shares, valued at $24.10 million in 2018Q1, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Mastercard Inc Cl A (NYSE:MA) by 2,395 shares in the quarter, for a total of 99,631 shares, and has risen its stake in Alibaba Group Holding Ltd Sp A (NYSE:BABA).
